blocks.text: Korean actress Lee Se-young is drawing attention lately not only for stealing Emperor Sovieshu away from Empress Navier in “The Remarried Empress”, but also for her scene-stealing portrayal of a scheming slave who has viewers seething with anger. “The Remarried Empress,” starring Ju Ji-hoon as the Emperor, and Shin Min-ah as the Empress, is the latest offering from Disney+ that is taking viewers by storm. The series also stars Lee Jong-suk as Prince Heinrey. But it is Se-young’s portrayal of Rashta, the emperor’s mistress, that gave a juicy excuse to further hate on her character.
